scope.evidence_basis: Actual author reconstruction: The compactly supported chart pieces extend by zero smoothly at chart edges. Their finite sum norm fixes all background choices before the sequence. The partition-of-unity reconstruction and product/chain rules justify use of these chart norms; varying backgrounds are outside this result.

N-H-norm.objects: Scalar functions on compact M localized by a finite partition.
N-H-norm.domain: Compact smooth d-manifold without boundary, charts in R^d and 0<gamma<1.
N-H-norm.fixed_and_variable: Atlas, cutoffs and background stay fixed; u varies.
N-H-norm.hypotheses: Each cutoff has support compactly contained in its chart.
N-H-norm.equations: The finite norm and Holder seminorm are displayed.
N-H-norm.quantifiers: Sum over all fixed charts and all derivative multi-indices through order two.
N-H-norm.conclusion: The norm specifies exactly the C2gamma space and topology used downstream.
N-H-norm.local_definitions: Multi-index, zero extension and cutoff supports are defined locally.

findings: The compactly supported chart pieces extend by zero smoothly at chart edges. Their finite sum norm fixes all background choices before the sequence.
The partition-of-unity reconstruction and product/chain rules justify use of these chart norms; varying backgrounds are outside this result.
